title: Remove old graph records during a controlled upgrade
prerequisites: The cvw-old-* records must exist in a prior version; remove or rewrite every dependent reference first.
notes: A component uses FUSE {"remove":true} or RF components.<id>: null within its known industry/area.
RF null is supported only in specific keyed materialized collections. Do not generalize to loads, features, progressions, root or scalar fields.
FUSE removals also enumerate waterSurfaces, telegraphPoles, mapLabels and sceneClones; translation depends on their owner/handler.
